objects.name: base
objects.prompt:
Create one production-ready pixel art prop for a 1990s American shopping mall horror roguelite.

OBJECT: A waist-high indoor mall trash receptacle from the early/mid 1990s. Beige/taupe molded plastic body, rounded corners, dark charcoal plastic top, large recessed front trash opening, removable front access panel, and small metal latch. Add light age and wear: yellowed plastic, scratches, shoe scuffs, grime around seams, and one faded partially peeled sticker. Keep it mundane and believable, not destroyed or overtly horror-themed.

STYLE: Detailed late-SNES/GBA pixel art. Crisp hard pixels, clean clusters, selective outlines, minimal dithering, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no 3D-rendered look.

VIEW: 3/4 top-down game perspective, showing front, one side, and top.

SIZE: About 40x48 pixels.

LIGHTING: Neutral overhead fluorescent mall lighting.

OUTPUT: Transparent background. Exactly one isolated object. No floor, scenery, text, border, grid, extra props, or alternate angles. Must be directly usable as an in-game sprite.
